derivation: The checkpoint is the result of C2-join-continuation-limit-stop: a STOPPED instance whose one pass has every obligation DISCHARGED and none JOINED. A fresh available CLOCK sample asks the consumer to restart. LIFE-019 admits an all-DISCHARGED, not-JOINED pass in a STOPPED state when the retained stop decision and the direct completion bases prove the join was suppressed by fixed-point preflight failure; the retained LIMIT_EXCEEDED decision on the event that discharged the last obligation, with both direct bases, proves it. The CLOCK sample is recorded with no other change.
